reform.lever: SBD GCC 51–52 (advance payment, securities); FIDIC 2017 cl. 4.2, 14.2
reform.reform: Prescribed bond wording (URDG 758) with a notice-and-cure period before any call and reasons stated in the demand; release dates tied to taking-over and reduction of advance-payment security as it is recovered.

reform.lever: PPDA Act ss. 89–91 (administrative review) and Regulations 2023; SBD ITB
reform.reform: Standstill period and written reasons before award; publish evaluation reports; tighter review timelines so challenges are resolved before contract signature.
Cap on liquidated damages and a stated daily rate; set-off only after EOT determination.

reform.lever: SBD GCC 28, 44 (EOT, compensation events); FIDIC 2017 cl. 8.5, 20.2
reform.reform: Programme updates as a contract obligation; EOT determination deadline for the project manager; compensation events list.
Deadlines for the statement at completion and final statement with deemed acceptance if the engineer does not respond.
Pandemic and government-measure events listed expressly, with cost/time consequences.

reform.lever: SBD GCC 42–43 (payment certificates, payments); FIDIC 2017 cl. 14.6–14.8
reform.reform: Fixed certification and payment periods with deemed certification on default; automatic financing charges on late payment at a stated rate; consider statutory security-of-payment adjudication for public works.

reform.lever: SBD fraud & corruption provisions; FIDIC 2017 cl. 15.6
reform.reform: Integrity pact and audit rights in the SBD; explicit consequences and evidential standard for termination for corruption.

reform.lever: SBD GCC 59–60 (termination, payment on termination); FIDIC 2017 cl. 15–16
reform.reform: Closed list of fundamental breaches, mandatory notice-to-correct with cure period, and a valuation formula at termination.
Written variation orders with valuation before execution; cap on oral instructions.
Fee scales and payment milestones for consultants; professional indemnity requirements.

reform.lever: SBD GCC (possession of site; compensation events); FIDIC 2017 cl. 2.1; Roads Act 2019
reform.reform: Land acquisition and resettlement completed before award; late site possession as an automatic compensation event.

reform.lever: SBD GCC 34–35 (defects); FIDIC 2017 cl. 11; Building Control Act 2013 / Regs 2020
reform.reform: Joint defects inspection at taking-over; link building-control inspection records to the contract's defects regime.

tier.reform: Standing adjudicator named at award with fixed decision times and interim-binding decisions; clear 'condition precedent' wording so courts apply the tier consistently (Stage 8: tiers argued in 15% of decisions, enforced in 17%).

model.term: neighbouring districts, previous year (per decision, average)

legislation.title: East African Community Mediation Agreement Act, 2025
Mortgage Refinance Institutions Act, 2026
legislation.provisions: Brings mortgage refinance institutions under Bank of Uganda regulation so they can give primary lenders longer-term funding.

legislation.title: Valuation Act, 2026
legislation.status: Assented 19 Feb 2026; in force 19 Mar 2026 (per KTA Advocates alert)
legislation.provisions: Creates the Institute of Certified Valuers to license and regulate valuers and standardise valuation practice.

legislation.title: Building Control (Amendment) Act, 2026
legislation.provisions: Amends the Building Control Act, Cap. 136. Expands enforcement powers of the National Building Review Board (incl. power to order demolition of unsafe buildings); tighter rules for multi-storey buildings; strict liability for site accidents; scaled fines for illegal construction; negligence causing injury, death or property damage punishable by up to 500 currency points and/or up to 12 years' imprisonment.

legislation.title: Judicature (Court Annexed Mediation) Rules, 2026
legislation.provisions: Accreditation and registration of court-accredited mediators, code of conduct and complaints; roles of court, mediator, parties and advocates; new appellate mediation (Part V); mediation period, virtual sessions, confidentiality and inadmissibility; adoption, enforcement and setting aside of mediated settlements; mediator remuneration and costs.

legislation.title: Energy Efficiency and Conservation Act, 2026
legislation.provisions: Section 24 deals with energy efficiency and conservation in buildings; also minimum energy performance standards, energy audits, and sustainable public procurement.

legislation.title: Employment (Amendment) Act, 2026
legislation.provisions: Reported to repeal provisions of the Labour Disputes (Arbitration and Settlement) Act that let labour officers mediate, conciliate, arbitrate and adjudicate.

legislation.title: Roads (Management of Public Roads) Regulations, 2026
legislation.provisions: Part III, execution of road works: feasibility studies and detailed engineering designs, design reports and review, execution of road works, sourcing, selection and testing of materials, non-conventional materials, registration of road engineering laboratories, labour-based technology. Also covers road reserves, fees for extracting construction materials, and access roads.

legislation.title: Roads (Vehicle Dimensions, Vehicle Load Control and Enforcement Measures) Regulations, 2026
legislation.provisions: Vehicle dimension and axle-load control and enforcement on public roads.

legislation.title: Roads (Ferry Development and Management) Regulations, 2026
legislation.provisions: Development and management of ferries forming part of the road network.

legislation.title: Atomic Energy (Control of Radioactivity in Foodstuffs, Livestock Feeds, Fertilisers and Construction Materials) Regulations, 2026
legislation.provisions: Controls radioactivity levels in construction materials, among other products.
